# Approval policy — scratch verification gate (APRV-155)

```yaml approval-policy
version: "0.1"

defaults:
  autonomy: manual
  channel: cli
  approval_ttl: "10m"
  on_expiry: reject
  token_delivery: sealed

approvers:
  demo:
    channels: [cli]

classes:
  read.*:
    autonomy: autonomous
  exec.local:
    autonomy: manual
    approvers: [demo]
  communicate.email.external:
    autonomy: manual
    approvers: [demo]
  policy.edit:
    autonomy: manual
    approvers: [demo]

budgets:
  global:
    daily_actions: 25
```
